sourceOfTruth: GitHub issue #504 plus live issue range #505-#525

units.title: security(challenge-v2): add perception-sealed@v2 AEDS contracts
units.surface: shared contract metadata and validation constants
units.acceptanceBoundary: Contracts define issue, assignment, verify, proof and error envelopes without public JSON fallback.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): implement AEAD sealed token service
units.surface: sealed token service contract and tests
units.acceptanceBoundary: Token payload is opaque, authenticated, expiry-bound and action-bound; Passkey step-up remains separate.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): add non-semantic render recipe schema
units.acceptanceBoundary: Recipe remains non-semantic and client-rendered; server does not rasterize or generate images.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): keep challenge issue path stateless and DB/Redis-free
units.acceptanceBoundary: Issue hot path writes neither PostgreSQL nor Redis and only emits sealed assignments.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): implement O(1) verify path without image recomputation
units.acceptanceBoundary: Verify path does AEAD unseal, binding validation, constant-time compare, Redis gate and proof mint only.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): add Redis consume-once and attempt gate
units.acceptanceBoundary: Replay, expiry and attempt limits fail closed without adding DB writes to the issue hot path.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): implement text-task perception provider
units.acceptanceBoundary: Medium-risk Character challenge works through the provider interface and generic result envelopes.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): implement localization perception provider
units.acceptanceBoundary: High-risk Localization challenge composes with PoW and does not expose label-oracle detail.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): add feature-gated micro-interaction provider
units.acceptanceBoundary: Provider is feature-gated and can stay out of default production policy until benchmarked.

units.title: security(risk-control): add perception-sealed@v2 decision matrix
units.acceptanceBoundary: Low, medium, high and critical risk bands select the expected challenge or rejection path.

units.title: security(risk-control): implement early reject, queue, and PoSpace routing for critical risk
units.acceptanceBoundary: Critical risk does not keep spending server resources on perception challenge issue.

units.title: frontend(challenge-v2): add worker renderer for non-semantic render recipes
units.acceptanceBoundary: Worker renders recipes without server images and without business-form coupling.

units.title: frontend(challenge-v2): add FsusUI perception challenge components
units.acceptanceBoundary: Character, Localization and Micro Interaction UI states remain provider-driven and accessible.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): harden label-oracle behavior and generic failure responses
units.acceptanceBoundary: Failure responses remain generic and timing/attempt behavior does not reveal labels.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): add async audit and risk event writer for hot-path isolation
units.acceptanceBoundary: PostgreSQL is used for asynchronous audit and aggregation, not challenge issue hot-path state.

units.title: security(observability): add perception-sealed@v2 metrics and readiness gates
units.acceptanceBoundary: Readiness distinguishes disabled, observe, enforce and provider-missing states.

units.title: tests(security): add perception-sealed@v2 red-team and regression benchmark
units.acceptanceBoundary: Benchmarks exercise label-oracle, replay, cost and abuse-path regression cases.

units.title: admin(security): add perception-sealed@v2 policy controls and dashboard metrics
units.acceptanceBoundary: Admin controls require admin principal and step-up proof; RiskControl proof never replaces MFA proof.

units.title: tests(security): add full perception-sealed@v2 contract, integration, E2E, and performance matrix
units.acceptanceBoundary: Matrix covers anonymous, authenticated, admin, notification stream and binary boundaries as applicable.

units.title: docs(security): document perception-sealed@v2 threat model, protocol, and rollout
units.surface: threat model, protocol and rollout docs
units.acceptanceBoundary: Docs explain protocol, rollout, emergency disable and non-goals without exposing bypass detail.

units.title: security(challenge-v2): wire perception providers into ChallengeOrchestrator and binary challenge API
units.acceptanceBoundary: Providers are invoked through ChallengeOrchestrator and AEDS endpoints fail closed for unsupported kinds.
